content: MEGA has NO OAuth: third-party apps must handle the user's raw email+password (meganz/sdk issue 2575 is an open enhancement request). The official MEGA SDK broke in browsers (used non-standard __proto__); community megajs library (qgustavor/mega) re-implements crypto for browsers but pure-JS crypto is slow and bundles are large (crypto-browserify huge). WebCrypto streaming not supported so old pure-JS crypto path used in browser. Parity gaps vs Drive: no OAuth, credential-handling burden, smaller ecosystem, perf cost of client-side crypto.
